name: ai_resume
description: The project integrates tailwind, clerk (third-party app account login), Alibaba Qianwen platform API, next-themes style, ReactQuill (RichEdit component), lucide-react image component, multiple components of shadcn, react-colorful component, mongoose component, etc., uses mongodb, and the hosting space is vercel.

paragraphs: This is a Next.js project bootstrapped with create-next-app. It should be noted that the original video explanation did not disclose the github project code to the public. The differences between this project and the project explained in the video are mainly in two aspects:
The source code address of this project is on github, deployed on vercel, and can be tried online. A little money was recharged on the Bailian platform for AI generation.
features: This project is developed using typescript, while the project explained in the video is developed using js;
The AI ​​integrated in this project is the API of Alibaba Bailian Platform, while the project explained in the video integrates Google's Gemini API.
